driver_structure.why_994: The 200-file dirty budget admits only one closure prefix per build. body promoted 97,999 dependents in 490 calls, api 34,025 in 171, and config 65,998 in 330; together those three stages account for 991 of 994 incremental calls.
driver_structure.why_8_full: Two cold full-mode builds plus one full_control after each of the six stages reached through batch_10. The protocol would require two additional full controls for batch_100 and batch_1000.

root_causes.name: Repeated exact 15-table parity is the dominant non-build cost

evidence.batch10_parity_additional_runtime: started but had no completion event before deadline
evidence.implementation: streaming.rs 325-378 deletes scratch rows per table, spools both DB sides, orders both streams, value-compares every row, and hashes every row

root_causes.complexity: For every cold/stage checkpoint, work is proportional to all canonical rows/bytes on both 100k indexes plus SQLite ordering. The driver repeats this after each full control.
root_causes.boundary: Any optimization must preserve all 15 tables, duplicate-preserving serialized order, Value equality before hashing, per-side digests, difference counts/examples and the existing resource limits. Skipping checkpoints or weakening the oracle would change the protocol and is not an acceptable repair.

root_causes.name: Bounded dirty closure causes 991 repeated unscoped 100k builds

evidence.raw_fact: Every body/api/config resume reports files_scanned=100000 even when files_parsed is 1/1/0.

root_causes.complexity: With corpus N, dirty closure D and budget B=200, the driver performs K≈ceil(D/B) full index-tool calls. Because build_index_report(false) supplies no changed_paths, each call uses the unscoped scan path, yielding O(K*N) file visits in addition to reconciliation and commit work.
material_fix_points: A correctness-preserving resume-aware scoped path that does not re-walk 100k files when the persisted frontier is the only pending work
Reduce repeated commit-side frontier/output work without changing the 200-file admission semantics or freshness/error boundaries
root_causes.boundary: Blindly changing the benchmark to pass changed_paths, increasing dirty_budget, or collapsing resumes changes the registered protocol. A product-level optimization must preserve ordinary index-tool discovery of unannounced filesystem changes.

root_causes.name: Eight repeated full controls spend most of their time staging full snapshots
root_causes.complexity: The driver performs an independent full rebuild after cold and after each completed stage. build_plan.rs lines 319-337 routes each full build through write_full_snapshot_build_staging over the 100k resolved units.
root_causes.boundary: The full controls are required independent oracles; removing or reusing an earlier full database would invalidate the stage-specific comparison.

pr188_assessment.verdict: credible scoped SQL-work reduction candidate, not established as the dominant deadline cause

old_g3_path.behavior: probe_cap = cap + excluded.len(); SQL applies LIMIT before exclusion; Rust filters completed paths afterward

pr188_path.head: cc177ddc9e6b8180b8d847539787672e7b689a1a
pr188_path.behavior: serializes the exact completed set as JSON and applies NOT IN(json_each(...)) before a fixed cap+1 LIMIT

directly_related_evidence.caveat: DirtyPlanExplanation merges resolution_dependents_with_work and unchanged surface_dependents_bounded work, so these totals cannot all be assigned to PR188.
directly_related_evidence.dense_prefix_mechanism: As completed grows, the old returned-row bound can grow approximately quadratically across resumes; PR188 removes that specific completed-prefix return amplification.

evidence_against_dominance: PR188 does not alter p8_scale.rs, the 994-call loop, full controls, scanner, commit path or parity oracle.
It should not materially reduce the 490/171/330 resume counts because the old probe_cap already compensated for completed paths and selected roughly 200 new dependents per call.

First-to-last quartile SQL work grows sharply while prepare wall grows modestly: body rows 48.7k→288.1k and VM 3.53m→13.30m while prepare 2.98s→3.36s; api rows 4.5k→30.3k while prepare 2.97s→3.03s; config rows 32.3k→226.2k while prepare 3.28s→3.35s.
The independent PR188 review records a scattered-exclusion SQLite counterexample with VM callbacks increasing 22.57%; there is no universal speedup.
PR188 CI proves correctness/source controls, but emitted no numerical Rust VM or 100k wall measurements.
pr188_assessment.maximum_attribution_boundary: Even the entire affected prepare_us total (3,141.3s) is only an upper bound containing scan, parsing, resolution and snapshot work; it is not a measured PR188 saving. No share of that time can presently be assigned causally to PR188.
pr188_assessment.conclusion: PR188 may materially reduce dense completed-prefix query work and could help, but the original G3 archive does not support claiming it is the main cause or that it alone would complete within five hours.

final_decision.reason: The fixed G3 rep0 100k shard is a preserved deadline failure. Root-cause diagnostics and PR188 CI do not replace the required complete N30/150-shard study.
